title: Road to Forever launch plan steps
description: launch-plan-steps.json: phase id -> list of steps. Phase ids are the data-phase attributes of the page's <div class="phase">. A step resolves in this order: its own fields, then race.<race>, then cls.<CLASS>, then preset.<id>; an object replaces the fields it names, false hides the step for good (no later layer shows it again). A key may name several races or classes separated by spaces ("dwarf gnome"). Rules a schema cannot say (ids unique across every phase, race / class / preset names exist, every phase has a section on the page) are checked by `node addon/tools/gen_plan_data.js --validate`, which build.py and CI run.

tag.description: [kind, text]: dng = dungeon, unv = unverified, opt = optional

layer.description: Fields a race / class / preset layer may replace.

layers.description: Key = one or more race / class / preset names separated by spaces; value = a layer, or false to hide the step.

id.description: Also the checkbox storage key and the addon's tick key: keep it stable.

lvl.description: Level or range as shown ("20", "1–12", "~5") or a label ("Plan", "Early"). Only numeric ones can be "now" on the page.

quests.description: Quest ids the addon's Follow the plan reads.

reach.description: Level by which the step should be done.

only.description: Show the step to these races / classes only.
